title: 2031 — First composite hulls product ships at scale: goethite fibers sy
definition: 2031 milestone on the Limpet Tooth Composites roadmap.
description:
First composite hulls product ships at scale: goethite fibers synthesis proven outside the lab.

What must be true first: the goethite fibers results have to replicate outside the lab, composite logistics manufacturing must reach pilot scale, and mineralization operations need a year of continuous runtime. Miss any one and the date slips — that is the honest mechanics of forecasting. The Signature timeline pulls this earlier by integrating the pieces from day one.

Signals to watch: peer-reviewed goethite fibers demonstrations, composite logistics cost curves bending down, and operators — not vendors — reporting mineralization uptime. When all three flash green, 2031 stops being a forecast and starts being a schedule. (5 years from the 2026 baseline.)

title: Readiness Estimator: Limpet Tooth Composites
definition: Estimates Limpet Tooth Composites readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Limpet Tooth Composites components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a composite hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Limpet Tooth Composites Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Limpet Tooth Composites operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Limpet Tooth Composites installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 72961 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where goethite fibers monitoring, composite logistics redundancy, or mineralization maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Limpet Tooth Composites Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Limpet Tooth Composites: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Limpet Tooth Composites — composites inspired by the strongest biomaterial.

Phase 1 — Prove (goethite fibers): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (composite logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (mineralization): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (hardness records): composite hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and tools-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.

Each phase has exit criteria.
Unites all 20 records.
